name_reason: Compliant and accurate: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), battle_ domain (battle map dimension), descriptor map_width_tiles precisely names the value (current battle map width in tiles). The _tiles unit suffix is semantic, not a Ghidra address residue. Reflects the scalar data type via the singular descriptor; mirrors the companion data_fd2_battle_map_height_tiles @ 0x53AC5.
purpose: Width of the current battle map in tiles (X dimension); the row-major column stride used to address the tile-map grid.
logic_summary: Zero-init BSS scalar in .object2. Written by exactly two functions at chapter/save-load time: fd2_load_chapter_battle_data @ 0x10928 and fd2_load_save_and_init_engine @ 0x10224, both as data_fd2_battle_map_width_tiles = (int)*(short *)_battle_tile_map -- read the first 16-bit field of the decrypted FDFIELD.DAT tile-map header (MOVSX, signed) and widen into the 32-bit slot. Consumed by ~30 readers as the row stride for tile-grid indexing (e.g. fd2_composite_battle_tile_map computes ((row + win_y) * width + win_x) * 4) and as the right-edge clamp for cursor movement (width - 1). Companion of data_fd2_battle_map_height_tiles @ 0x53AC5 (second 16-bit field of the same header). Constant within a chapter.
element_semantics: Single 32-bit integer = number of tile columns of the active battle map (X dimension). Loaded by sign-extending the first 16-bit word of the decrypted tile-map header; used directly as the multiplier/stride for row-major tile-map addressing and as a cursor right-edge bound.
comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate but terser than the companion height-tiles comment: it stated the value, source field, MOVSX widen, and BSS storage, but did not name the two writers nor the dominant consumer role (row-major column stride for tile-grid addressing / cursor right-edge clamp), which is how the ~30 readers actually use it.
notes: Both writers verified by decompiling fd2_load_chapter_battle_data (0x10928) and fd2_load_save_and_init_engine (0x10224); both assign (int)*(short *)_battle_tile_map. Reader role verified in fd2_composite_battle_tile_map (0x1219D): pTile_meta = ((row + win_y) * data_fd2_battle_map_width_tiles + win_x) * 4 + tile_map_ptr. xrefs_to confirms ~30 READ sites and exactly 2 WRITE sites. Ghidra plate at 0x53AC1 already carries the full detailed description (width X-dim, BSS, 2 writers reading first 16-bit field MOVSX, companion height, ~30 readers using row stride, emit_class zero-bss); it is semantically consistent with the refined src comment, so plate left unchanged. src comment augmented to add writer names and the row-stride/cursor-bound consumer role for parity with the height-tiles comment.
